meta.name: knowledge-agent
meta.description: Build and query AI-powered knowledge bases from claude-mem observations. Use when users want to create focused "brains" from their observation history, ask questions about past work patterns, or compile expertise on specific topics.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从对话历史构建可查询的知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望从日常对话中自动提炼知识并随时查询
copy.tagline_en: Build queryable knowledge bases from conversation history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automatically extract knowledge from daily conversations and query it anytime

howto.what: Claude 能把你过去的工作观察记录按项目或主题筛选，编成专题知识库；你向它提问时，它会基于这个库回答，并在后续追问中保持上下文。
howto.when: 当你想建立基于过往观察记录的专题知识库、询问过去工作模式，或整理某主题经验时触发。

say.text: 把 claude-mem 项目里关于 hooks 的观察记录建成一个专题知识库。
say.note: 相当于执行 build_corpus，按项目和主题筛选。

say.text: 重建 hooks-expertise 库，然后重新加载更新后的内容。

howto.what_en: Claude can filter your past work observations by project or topic into focused knowledge bases. When you ask questions, it answers from that base and keeps context across follow-ups.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to build a focused knowledge base from past observations, ask about previous work patterns, or compile expertise on a specific topic.

say_en.text: Build a knowledge base from the claude-mem observations about hooks.
say_en.note: Runs build_corpus filtered by project and topic.

say_en.text: Using the 'hooks-expertise' base, tell me when each of the 5 lifecycle hooks fires.
say_en.note: Queries the corpus and answers from its content.

say_en.text: Rebuild the hooks-expertise base and reload the updated content.
